name_en: Kinzanji miso — a chunky fermented paste studded with summer vegetables
summary_ja: 米麹と豆麹で冬瓜やなす、生姜、しその実などの夏野菜を漬け込んで発酵させる、そのまま食べる「なめ味噌」。もとは寺で夏野菜を冬に食べるための保存食で、県内各地のほか和歌山や千葉でも食されると伝わる。
summary_en: Rice and soy koji ferment summer vegetables — winter melon, eggplant, ginger, shiso seed — into a chunky paste eaten as-is rather than used to season. Originally a temple preserve for carrying summer vegetables into winter, it's said to be eaten across the prefecture and as far as Wakayama and Chiba.
source_title: 金山寺味噌 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mago chazuke — pounded raw horse mackerel over rice, doused in hot tea
summary_ja: たたいた新鮮なアジをごはんにのせ、熱いお茶や湯をそそいで醤油とわさびで食べる。漁の合間に「まごまごしないで早く食え」の意から名がついたと伝わる、伊豆半島全域の漁師めしとされる。
summary_en: Pounded fresh horse mackerel is piled on rice and doused with hot tea or water, seasoned with soy sauce and wasabi. Its name is said to come from a call to eat quickly between hauls — a fisherman's meal found across the Izu peninsula.
source_title: まご茶漬け 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
